towns.name: Khayyaban
towns.summary: Khayyaban (47.6S 24.7E) is a quiet Gharu'ndim waypoint town at the southern end of the Yushad Ridge, founded with the support of the Aluvian Lord Balthall when the great road from Zaikhal was pushed south to link Uziz with isolated Qalaba'r. It climbs the eastern flank of the ridge in terraces: a middle terrace (z 46-56) with the nullified skeleton statue on its pillar, the Town Network portal, the tavern The Skeleton's Mug with glowing lanterns, a yellow-green dome and a rooftop-garden house; an upper terrace (z 70-88) with more rooftop gardens (Desert Magic Supplies, Safruya's Bows); the Victory Residential Halls church tower to the south; and below, on the road (z 35), the Life Stone with a burning fire bowl beside the Blade of the Desert shop. East of the statue a sunken pit (z 20) holds an old well and the Destroyed Lin Portal; a flat mesa (z 102) rises beyond the road to the east and the ridge (z 100-116) towers to the west.
